probe: sf-table against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20; §18.4 many entries)
format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is the SIMAI Framework's tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs through tests/browser/package-manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: 1 000 rows: only the rows in view and a margin are drawn, at most thirty nodes a row; a scroll moves the window and sf-table-window reports it
probes.covers: §18.4 window, gate 17 nodes per entry, events.window

steps.script: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); t.setColumns([{key: 'title', label: 'Название', sortable: true}, {key: 'status', label: 'Статус'}, {key: 'amount', label: 'Сумма', type: 'number'}]); t.setRows(Array.from({length: 1000}, (_, i) => ({id: String(i + 1), title: 'Запись ' + (i + 1), status: ['active', 'done'][i % 2], amount: i * 3, revision: 'r1', actions: ['view', 'publish']}))); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); const drawn = t.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-row-id]').length; const body = t.querySelector('tbody'); let nodes = 0; const w = document.createTreeWalker(body, NodeFilter.SHOW_ALL); while (w.nextNode()) nodes++; return drawn > 10 && drawn <= 100 && t.querySelector('table').getAttribute('aria-rowcount') === '1001' && nodes / drawn <= 30; })()

steps.script: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); window.__windows = []; t.addEventListener('sf-table-window', (event) => window.__windows.push(event.detail)); const row = t.querySelector('tbody tr[data-row-id]').getBoundingClientRect().height; window.scrollTo({top: t.querySelector('tbody').getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY + row * 500, behavior: 'instant'}); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); const seen = [...t.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-row-id]')].map((row) => Number(row.dataset.rowId)); const last = window.__windows.at(-1); return window.__windows.length >= 1 && last.first > 300 && !seen.includes(1) && seen.length <= 100 && seen.every((id) => id - 1 >= last.first && id - 1 <= last.last); })()

probes.title: the filter window's template row says its name: sf-radio is fetched when the window opens, so the row is not a handle and a menu with nothing between them

steps.script: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); t.setColumns([{key: 'title', label: 'Название', filter: {enabled: true}}, {key: 'status', label: 'Статус'}]); t.setRows(Array.from({length: 12}, (_, i) => ({id: String(i + 1), title: 'Запись ' + (i + 1), status: 'active'}))); t.templates = [{key: 'default', label: 'Все записи', default: true}]; return true; })()

(() => { const t = document.getElementById('t'); const anchor = t.querySelector('button, [role="button"]') || t; t.openContextMenu({currentTarget: anchor, target: anchor, composedPath: () => [anchor], preventDefault() {}, stopPropagation() {}}, {menu: 'filter-settings'}); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('[data-filter-template-key]'); if (!row) return false; const radio = row.querySelector('sf-radio'); if (!radio || !customElements.get('sf-radio')) return false; const drawn = radio.querySelector('.sf-radio-button, label'); const box = drawn?.getBoundingClientRect(); return Boolean(box) && box.width > 24 && box.height > 8 && row.textContent.includes('Все записи'); })()
